Project brief

This document stands in for a deliverable sent to a client. Its PDF twin, brief.pdf, opens first in the review, as pages, because the PDF is what the reader receives.

Scope

Three pages, one form and a price list. Every page is reviewed on a desktop and a phone before it goes out, and every note lands on disk the moment it is saved.

Timeline

A first draft in week one, a reviewed draft in week two, and the handover once every open note is closed or answered.
